sources: microscopy-microvascular-networks: Blinder et al. 2013 mouse vibrissa cortex networks with the Schmid/Weber flow solution (Zenodo 269650, CC BY 4.0)
vesselgraph-mouse: Paetzold et al. 2021 whole-brain mouse vessel graphs, 9 animals from 3 strains (CC BY-NC 4.0)
venat: Huck et al. 7T QSM venous atlas over 20 subjects x 5 measurements, MNI 0.5 mm (figshare 7205960, CC BY 4.0)

tissue_to_capillary_um.note: distance from a uniform random tissue point to the nearest capillary CENTRELINE, minus nothing -- subtract a ~2 um radius for the wall

penetrating_vessel_spacing_um.note: twice this is roughly the spacing of the penetrating vessels, which is the length scale a vascular unit is defined on

flow_unit_um3_per_s.note: the release documents no unit.  the Poiseuille route assumes only that the effective viscosity is in the plasma-to-whole-blood range; the perfusion route assumes only that mouse cortical CBF is of order 100 ml/100g/min.  a decade either way is ruled out by the second.

perfusion.note: the boundary figure is an UPPER bound and includes blood that enters one cut capillary at a lateral face and leaves by another without perfusing anything.  the arteriolar figure is the one to read; that in == out at the boundary to machine precision is a check that the solution is conservative, not a perfusion estimate

fahraeus_lindqvist.note: median apparent viscosity implied by each segment's own solved pressure drop.  this is the correction vascular_tree_adjacency declines to apply and documents the direction of; the direction is confirmed here

capillary_transit_time_s.note: capillary blood volume over arteriolar inflow.  a mean, and the heterogeneity around it is what raises effective extraction above what the mean predicts -- see the validity note on `tissue_exchange`

dissipation_share.note: share of total viscous dissipation dP*Q, not of series resistance: the capillary bed is massively parallel and a sum of segment resistances is not the resistance of anything

units.note:
which unit each column is in, decided from the data rather than assumed.

    the release documents none of it and the answer is not uniform, which is
    exactly why it has to be settled before any number is quoted.

length_density_mm_per_mm3_over_bbox.note: over the BOUNDING BOX, which a brain fills to maybe 0.7.  a lower bound on the tissue density by that factor

murray.parent_assumed: widest of the three (this release carries no flow direction), which biases the exponent DOWN

group_icc.note: one-way random-effects ICC over the group label.  unlike the deviation correlation above, a between-group term is NOT removed by centring on the grand mean, so this is the estimator with dynamic range at small n

human_population_venogram.read_it_as: a population venous tree, and a LOWER bound on how much two people's macro vasculature differs: the atlas has a skeleton only where subjects agreed enough to leave one, and registration turns positional variability into blur rather than into variance
